report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with sub-300ms durations; no 502s, errors, or dependency failures appear in metrics or logs. The only anomaly is a mildly elevated p95 (~412ms) on /v1/checkout, which is insufficient to attribute a root cause. No candidate is substantiated; more evidence is required to localize latency or rule out alternatives.
